title.zh: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额
title.en: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额

current_state.zh: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, said it will issue tokenized fund shares for the first time early next year in partnership with digital securities infrastructure provider Prometheum, with money market funds possibly among the first products.
current_state.en: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, said it will issue tokenized fund shares for the first time early next year in partnership with digital securities infrastructure provider Prometheum, with money market funds possibly among the first products.
